rationale: Target: the end bucket (aggregate 0.54, reply_quality 0.25, action_correct 0.63). Five of its turns are labelled speak but the agent says goodbye early. S28: 'no credit cards / that's my son's' is not an explicit 'no debt', so the label asks about personal loans. S31/S32: first 'wrong number', so the label is the wrong-number rebuttal. S30: 'someone's taking care of it', so the label is the competition rebuttal. S36: an amount under $7k plus 'bye bye', so the label is the GATE 2 personal-loans question. The script already has each of these rules, scattered across three skills, and the agent skips them; the agent-eval review shows the same pattern in prod traces. This edit adds one compact BEFORE ANY GOODBYE check at the top of ending_the_call.md and changes nothing else. It only blocks an end_call, and it explicitly leaves do-not-call, callback, voicemail/IVR, abuse, the not-engaging ladder and the instruction-change goodbye alone. That covers every end_call-labelled sample: S01/S06/S11/S12/S35 (ladder or abuse), S14 (callback), S27 (explicit no debt), S29 (voicemail), S33 (stop bothering me), S34. So speak_and_act, which is scored only on transfer/end turns, should stay flat. Prediction: 8 to 12 of the 15 target rows flip to speak, giving action_correct +0.07 to +0.11. Most of them also become on-script for reply_quality, around +0.1 on the expected-speak rows. Weighted quality should rise about +0.05 to +0.08, above the 0.03 epsilon. Note: baseline.json has no failures[], so these targets come from the previous session's round_005 failures and agent_evals/review.md, not from per-row traces of this baseline. About +250 prompt tokens (~2% of 11.5k), so first-action p50 should stay near 580-600ms and p90 under 800ms.
